title: Proper coincidence of compact-support and ordinary cohomology
statement:
In the notation of
[def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], if $Y$ is
proper then the
compact-support direct image and the ordinary direct image agree,

$$
Ra_{Y!}\cong Ra_{Y*},
$$

so that $H_c^i(Y,K)\cong H^i(Y,K)$ for every $K$.

proof.text: For every compactification c of the proper structure morphism f, c.i has clopen range. The fixed-scalar extension-by-zero to direct-image transformation is invertible on a clopen immersion. Transport preservation of K-injective complexes across this isomorphism, derive it, and compose the derived direct images of c.i and c.g. Their composite is f by c.comm. Transport this comparison through the intrinsic/fixed-scalar derived equivalences and cancel the source equivalence. This gives a natural comparison on the whole finite-coefficient derived category, which can be restricted to the constructible subcategory.

Compare any two integral compactification functors using the integral shriek composition theorem for id_Y followed by f, with the same compactifications of id_Y and f and the two desired compactifications of their composite. Compose one composition isomorphism inverse with the other. Use the identity compactification c0 of f. The completed coefficient map at id_Y is the canonical identity-site comparison: on each finite projection this is the naturality equation for the constant-section sheafification unit, and uniqueness of the completed coefficient map gives the assertion. SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr₂ and pushforwardId then identify completed-module direct image at id_Y with identity. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies its pullback, and then open extension, with identity. Derive this identification. The canonical completed-ring direct-image map for f is the adjoint of its published completed inverse-image comparison, so the two completed pushforward models agree. Apply the normalized qcqs compact-support realization at c0, remove identity open extension, and whisker the compactification comparison. This proves the integral natural functor isomorphism.

The rational shriek composition theorem applied to id_Y followed by f compares the rational functors at c and c0. For every pair of normalized algebraically closed coefficient actions, obtain an action for the identity compactification of id_Y from finite-field independence. The algebraically closed shriek composition theorem compares both supplied actions with the same composite action; compose the inverse of one comparison with the other. This gives the universally quantified action clause without choosing or changing either supplied action.

For an integral constructible input, use the system compact realization at c0 and the system identity-open adjunction to identify its ambient image with the limit realization of the ordinary direct-image system. The directImage_roos theorem gives a Roos vertex for that realization. The recorded integralImage is also a derived limit of exactly sfDirectImageTerm with sfDirectImageTransition, by its defining constructibility witness. Uniqueness of the derived-limit vertex gives an isomorphism between these two objects. Lift it to the full integral constructible subcategory and compose with the compactification comparison and the recorded functor object equation. Map this integral object isomorphism through rational localization, and then through the finite-stage inclusion, to obtain the rational and algebraically closed image clauses.

Map the finite comparison at each input through pointFiniteSections and its derived homology functor. Map the integral, rational and algebraically closed image comparisons through the corresponding point fibre functors and coefficient cohomology functors. Functors preserve isomorphisms, giving every sections and integer-degree cohomology clause. These are precisely the recorded ordinary and compact sections and cohomology definitions.

blueprint_update.statement:
In the notation of
[def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], if $Y$ is
proper then the
compact-support direct image and the ordinary direct image agree,

$$
Ra_{Y!}\cong Ra_{Y*},
$$

so that $H_c^i(Y,K)\cong H^i(Y,K)$ for every $K$.

proof.text:
If $Y$ is proper, the identity is a compactification of the structure
morphism $a_Y$, namely
$Y\xrightarrow{\operatorname{id}}Y\xrightarrow{a_Y}\Spec k$
with $a_Y$ proper, so at every finite coefficient level
$Ra_{Y!,n}=Ra_{Y*,n}$ by
[def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and the comparison maps of
that definition are identities for the identity refinement; hence the
compactification-independent functor $Ra_{Y!}$ is naturally
identified with the ordinary derived direct image $Ra_{Y*}$ of
[def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Applying the equivalence
$\operatorname{Fib}_s$ of
[def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology] to both sides gives
$\RGammac(Y,K)\cong\RGamma(Y,K)$, hence
$H_c^i(Y,K)\cong H^i(Y,K)$ for every $K$, by the definitions of the
ordinary and compactly supported cohomology groups in
[def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology].
